# Media Management Stack
# VPN-protected download clients + library managers
# Following TRaSH Guides best practices

name: media-management

networks:
  media-net:
    driver: bridge

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Gluetun - VPN Gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)
  # ==========================================================================
  gluetun:
    image: qmcgaw/gluetun:v3.40.0
    container_name: gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    networks:
      - media-net
    environment:
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=nordvpn
      - VPN_TYPE=wireguard
      - WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY=${NORDVPN_WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - SERVER_COUNTRIES=Netherlands
      - TZ=America/New_York
      # Allow access to container network for inter-service communication
      - FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24
      # Health check settings
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_INITIAL=30s
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_ADDITION=10s
    ports:
      # qBittorrent
      - "8080:8080"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"
      # SABnzbd
      - "8085:8085"
      # Prowlarr
      - "9696:9696"
      # FlareSolverr
      - "8191:8191"
    volumes:
      - gluetun-data:/gluetun
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- ifconfig.me || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # qBittorrent - BitTorrent Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:5.0.2
    container_name: qbittorrent
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - WEBUI_PORT=8080
    volumes:
      - qbittorrent-config:/config
      - /data/torrents:/data/torrents
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prowlarr - Indexer Manager (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  prowlarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:1.28.2
    container_name: prowlarr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - prowlarr-config:/config
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # FlareSolverr - Cloudflare Bypass (via VPN, optional)
  # ==========================================================================
  flaresolverr:
    image: ghcr.io/flaresolverr/flaresolverr:v3.3.21
    container_name: flaresolverr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
      - LOG_HTML=false
      - CAPTCHA_SOLVER=none
      - TZ=America/New_York
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Sonarr - TV Show Management
  # ==========================================================================
  # NOTE: After switching from host network, update Sonarr's download client
  # settings to use container names (e.g., gluetun:8080 for qBittorrent)
  sonarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:4.0.11
    container_name: sonarr
    networks:
      - media-net
    ports:
      - "8989:8989"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - sonarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Radarr - Movie Management
  # ==========================================================================
  radarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/radarr:5.16.3
    container_name: radarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - radarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Lidarr - Music Management
  # ==========================================================================
  lidarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/lidarr:2.8.2
    container_name: lidarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - lidarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Bazarr - Subtitle Management
  # ==========================================================================
  bazarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bazarr:1.5.1
    container_name: bazarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - bazarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # SABnzbd - Usenet Download Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  sabnzbd:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sabnzbd:4.4.1
    container_name: sabnzbd
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - sabnzbd-config:/config
      - /data/usenet:/data/usenet
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Recyclarr - TRaSH Guides Sync
  # ==========================================================================
  recyclarr:
    image: ghcr.io/recyclarr/recyclarr:7.4.0
    container_name: recyclarr
    network_mode: host
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - RECYCLARR_CREATE_CONFIG=true
    volumes:
      - ./recyclarr:/config
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-media-management
  portainer-edge-agent:
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  gluetun-data:
  qbittorrent-config:
  prowlarr-config:
  sonarr-config:
  radarr-config:
  lidarr-config:
  bazarr-config:
  sabnzbd-config:
  portainer_agent_data:

# OpenTofu IaC Commands
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
# Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer|etc to specify which app

version: '3'

vars:
  TOFU_DIR: "tofu"

tasks:
  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - pwd
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d .terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app (optional: REPLACE='resource.name')"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply {{if .REPLACE}}-replace='{{.REPLACE}}' -auto-approve{{else}}tfplan{{end}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: '{{if .REPLACE}}true{{else}}test -f tfplan{{end}}'
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:rm:
    desc: "Remove a resource from state (APP, RESOURCE)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state rm '{{.RESOURCE}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, RESOURCE]

  tofu:import:
    desc: "Import existing resource into state (APP, ADDR, ID)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu import '{{.ADDR}}' '{{.ID}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, ADDR, ID]

  tofu:show:
    desc: "Show saved plan details for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu show tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

1→# Homelab Backup Strategy
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→Two-tier backup system with daily backups for user data services and weekly backups for infrastructure. All backups are synced to Backblaze B2 (encrypted) for off-site redundancy.
     6→
     7→## Backup Tiers
     8→
     9→### Daily Backups (2:00 AM)
    10→
    11→User data that changes frequently - kept for 7 days.
    12→
    13→| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
    14→|----|---------|-----------------|
    15→| 304 | Immich | PostgreSQL dump |
    16→| 501 | OpenWebUI | SQLite copy |
    17→| 502 | n8n | SQLite copy |
    18→
    19→### Weekly Backups (Sunday 3:00 AM)
    20→
    21→Infrastructure services that rarely change - kept for 4 weeks.
    22→
    23→| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
    24→|----|---------|-----------------|
    25→| 100 | Portainer | None |
    26→| 101 | Network Services (AdGuard) | None |
    27→| 200 | Traefik | None |
    28→| 201 | Dashboards | None |
    29→| 202 | Authelia | None |
    30→| 401 | Jellyfin | Jellystat PostgreSQL dump |
    31→| 402 | Media Management | None |
    32→| 500 | Monitoring | None |
    33→
    34→### Excluded Containers
    35→
    36→- **303 (immich-importer)** - Stateless, runs cron jobs only
    37→- **600 (desktop-tmp)** - Temporary GUI container
    38→
    39→## Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)
    40→
    41→All local backups are synced to Backblaze B2 with rclone crypt encryption.
    42→
    43→| Sync | Schedule | Source | Destination |
    44→|------|----------|--------|-------------|
    45→| Photos | Daily 3:00 AM | LXC 303 `/photos` | `b2-crypt:` |
    46→| Vzdump | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/vzdump` | `b2-crypt:vzdump` |
    47→| DB Dumps | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/database-dumps` | `b2-crypt:database-dumps` |
    48→
    49→### Daily Timeline
    50→
    51→```text
    52→2:00 AM - Daily vzdump backups (immich, openwebui, n8n)
    53→3:00 AM - Photos cloud sync to B2
    54→4:00 AM - Vzdump + DB dumps cloud sync to B2
    55→```
    56→
    57→## Storage Layout
    58→
    59→```text
    60→/tank/backups/
    61→├── vzdump/dump/           # Proxmox vzdump backups
    62→│   ├── vzdump-lxc-100-*.tar.zst
    63→│   ├── vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst
    64→│   └── ...
    65→└── database-dumps/        # Pre-backup database dumps
    66→    ├── immich-postgres-*.sql.gz
    67→    ├── jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz
    68→    ├── openwebui-*.db
    69→    └── n8n-*.db
    70→```
    71→
    72→## Taskfile Commands
    73→
    74→### Local Backups
    75→
    76→```bash
    77→# Sync backup config to Proxmox
    78→task backup:sync
    79→
    80→# View status
    81→task backup:status
    82→
    83→# Manual backups
    84→task backup:now APP=openwebui    # Single container
    85→task backup:all                   # All containers
    86→
    87→# List backups for an app
    88→task backup:list APP=immich
    89→
    90→# Restore container
    91→task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-304-2025_12_07-02_00_00.tar.zst TARGET_ID=305
    92→
    93→# Immich database operations
    94→task backup:immich:db              # Manual dump
    95→task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
    96→```
    97→
    98→### Cloud Backups
    99→
   100→```bash
   101→# Trigger cloud sync
   102→task cloud:sync              # Both vzdump + photos
   103→task cloud:sync:vzdump       # Vzdump only
   104→task cloud:sync:photos       # Photos only
   105→
   106→# Check status
   107→task cloud:status            # B2 bucket sizes
   108→task cloud:status:photos     # Photos backup status
   109→task cloud:progress          # Check if sync is running
   110→task cloud:dry-run           # Preview what would sync
   111→
   112→# View logs
   113→task cloud:logs              # Vzdump sync logs
   114→task cloud:logs:photos       # Photos sync logs
   115→```
   116→
   117→## Restore Procedures
   118→
   119→### Full Container Restore
   120→
   121→```bash
   122→# 1. List available backups
   123→task backup:list APP=openwebui
   124→
   125→# 2. Restore to new container ID (recommended for testing)
   126→task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst TARGET_ID=505
   127→
   128→# 3. Verify restored container
   129→ssh root@homelab "pct start 505"
   130→
   131→# 4. If verified, swap with original:
   132→#    - Stop original (501)
   133→#    - Update network config on new container
   134→#    - Start new container
   135→```
   136→
   137→### Database-Only Restore
   138→
   139→```bash
   140→# Immich PostgreSQL
   141→task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
   142→
   143→# Other databases - manual restore from /tank/backups/database-dumps/
   144→ssh root@homelab "ls -lh /tank/backups/database-dumps/"
   145→```
   146→
   147→### Extract Files from Backup
   148→
   149→```bash
   150→ssh root@homelab
   151→cd /tmp
   152→tar -xf /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst
   153→# Navigate and extract needed files
   154→```
   155→
   156→## Monitoring
   157→
   158→### Check Backup Status
   159→
   160→```bash
   161→# View scheduled jobs
   162→ssh root@homelab "cat /etc/pve/jobs.cfg"
   163→
   164→# View hook script logs
   165→ssh root@homelab "tail -50 /var/log/vzdump-hooks.log"
   166→
   167→# Check local storage usage
   168→task backup:status
   169→
   170→# Check cloud backup status

# Homelab Backup Strategy

## Overview

Two-tier backup system with daily backups for user data services and weekly backups for infrastructure. All backups are synced to Backblaze B2 (encrypted) for off-site redundancy.

## Backup Tiers

### Daily Backups (2:00 AM)

User data that changes frequently - kept for 7 days.

| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
|----|---------|-----------------|
| 304 | Immich | PostgreSQL dump |
| 501 | OpenWebUI | SQLite copy |
| 502 | n8n | SQLite copy |

### Weekly Backups (Sunday 3:00 AM)

Infrastructure services that rarely change - kept for 4 weeks.

| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
|----|---------|-----------------|
| 100 | Portainer | None |
| 101 | Network Services (AdGuard) | None |
| 200 | Traefik | None |
| 201 | Dashboards | None |
| 202 | Authelia | None |
| 401 | Jellyfin | Jellystat PostgreSQL dump |
| 402 | Media Management | None |
| 500 | Monitoring | None |

### Excluded Containers

- **303 (immich-importer)** - Stateless, runs cron jobs only
- **600 (desktop-tmp)** - Temporary GUI container

## Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)

All local backups are synced to Backblaze B2 with rclone crypt encryption.

| Sync | Schedule | Source | Destination |
|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| Photos | Daily 3:00 AM | LXC 303 `/photos` | `b2-crypt:` |
| Vzdump | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/vzdump` | `b2-crypt:vzdump` |
| DB Dumps | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/database-dumps` | `b2-crypt:database-dumps` |

### Daily Timeline

```text
2:00 AM - Daily vzdump backups (immich, openwebui, n8n)
3:00 AM - Photos cloud sync to B2
4:00 AM - Vzdump + DB dumps cloud sync to B2
```

## Storage Layout

```text
/tank/backups/
├── vzdump/dump/           # Proxmox vzdump backups
│   ├── vzdump-lxc-100-*.tar.zst
│   ├── vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst
│   └── ...
└── database-dumps/        # Pre-backup database dumps
    ├── immich-postgres-*.sql.gz
    ├── jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz
    ├── openwebui-*.db
    └── n8n-*.db
```

## Taskfile Commands

### Local Backups

```bash
# Sync backup config to Proxmox
task backup:sync

# View status
task backup:status

# Manual backups
task backup:now APP=openwebui    # Single container
task backup:all                   # All containers

# List backups for an app
task backup:list APP=immich

# Restore container
task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-304-2025_12_07-02_00_00.tar.zst TARGET_ID=305

# Immich database operations
task backup:immich:db              # Manual dump
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
```

### Cloud Backups

```bash
# Trigger cloud sync
task cloud:sync              # Both vzdump + photos
task cloud:sync:vzdump       # Vzdump only
task cloud:sync:photos       # Photos only

# Check status
task cloud:status            # B2 bucket sizes
task cloud:status:photos     # Photos backup status
task cloud:progress          # Check if sync is running
task cloud:dry-run           # Preview what would sync

# View logs
task cloud:logs              # Vzdump sync logs
task cloud:logs:photos       # Photos sync logs
```

## Restore Procedures

### Full Container Restore

```bash
# 1. List available backups
task backup:list APP=openwebui

# 2. Restore to new container ID (recommended for testing)
task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst TARGET_ID=505

# 3. Verify restored container
ssh root@homelab "pct start 505"

# 4. If verified, swap with original:
#    - Stop original (501)
#    - Update network config on new container
#    - Start new container
```

### Database-Only Restore

```bash
# Immich PostgreSQL
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz

# Other databases - manual restore from /tank/backups/database-dumps/
ssh root@homelab "ls -lh /tank/backups/database-dumps/"
```

### Extract Files from Backup

```bash
ssh root@homelab
cd /tmp
tar -xf /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst
# Navigate and extract needed files
```

## Monitoring

### Check Backup Status

```bash
# View scheduled jobs
ssh root@homelab "cat /etc/pve/jobs.cfg"

# View hook script logs
ssh root@homelab "tail -50 /var/log/vzdump-hooks.log"

# Check local storage usage
task backup:status

# Check cloud backup status
task cloud:status
```

### Proxmox UI

Backup jobs visible at: **Datacenter > Backup**

## Files Reference

| File | Location | Purpose |
|------|----------|---------|
| Job config (source) | `scripts/backup/jobs.cfg` | Scheduled vzdump job definitions |
| Hook script (source) | `scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh` | Pre-backup database dumps |
| Job config (deployed) | `/etc/pve/jobs.cfg` | Synced via `task backup:sync` |
| Hook script (deployed) | `/var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh` | Synced via `task backup:sync` |
| Hook log | `/var/log/vzdump-hooks.log` | Hook script output |
| Cloud sync script | `/root/cloud-sync.sh` | Vzdump to B2 sync (on Proxmox) |
| Photos sync script | `/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh` | Photos to B2 sync (on LXC 303) |

## Adding New Containers

1. Edit `scripts/backup/jobs.cfg`:
   - Add container ID to `daily-user-data` (for user data) or `weekly-infrastructure` (for infra)
2. Edit `scripts/backup/backup-app.sh` and `scripts/backup/backup-list.sh`:
   - Add the app name to container ID mapping
3. (Optional) If container has a database, edit `scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh`:
   - Add a dump function and case in `backup-start`
4. Run `task backup:sync` to deploy configs to Proxmox

## Database Notes

### Immich (304)

- PostgreSQL with pgvecto-rs extension (ML embeddings)
- Container: `immich_postgres`
- Dumps kept 7 days

### Jellystat (401)

- PostgreSQL 15 for Jellyfin statistics
- Container: `jellystat-db`
- User/DB: `jellystat`
- Dumps kept 4 weeks

### OpenWebUI (501)

- SQLite at `/config/openwebui/webui.db`
- Contains chat history, users, settings
- Copied directly (no sqlite3 in container)

### n8n (502)

- SQLite at `/config/n8n/database.sqlite`
- Contains workflows, credentials, execution history

# Disaster Recovery Runbook

## Overview

This document outlines procedures for recovering the homelab from various failure scenarios. For detailed backup information, see [backups.md](./backups.md).

## Quick Reference

| Scenario | RTO | RPO | Procedure |
|----------|-----|-----|-----------|
| Single container failure | 15 min | < 24 hrs | [Container Recovery](#single-container-recovery) |
| Proxmox host failure | 2-4 hrs | < 24 hrs | [Full Host Recovery](#full-host-recovery) |
| Database corruption | 30 min | < 24 hrs | [Database Recovery](#database-recovery) |
| Network services down | 5 min | N/A | [Network Recovery](#network-services-recovery) |

## Service Dependencies

### Recovery Order (Critical Path)

Recovery must follow this order due to service dependencies:

```
1. Proxmox VE host
   └── 2. Network Services (LXC 101) - AdGuard DNS
       └── 3. Traefik (LXC 200) - Reverse proxy
           └── 4. Authelia (LXC 202) - SSO/Auth
               └── 5. All other services
```

### Tier 1: Infrastructure (Recover First)

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies | Critical For |
|----|---------|----|--------------|--------------|
| - | Proxmox VE | 192.168.1.215 | None | Everything |
| 101 | Network Services | 10.100.1.101 / 192.168.1.196 | Proxmox | DNS resolution |
| 200 | Traefik | 10.100.2.200 / 192.168.1.235 | DNS | HTTPS access to all services |
| 202 | Authelia | 10.100.2.202 | Traefik | Protected service access |

### Tier 2: Core Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 100 | Portainer | 10.100.1.100 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 500 | Monitoring | 10.100.5.100 | Traefik |
| 201 | Dashboards | 10.100.2.201 | Traefik |

### Tier 3: Application Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 304 | Immich | 10.100.3.104 / 192.168.1.222 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 401 | Jellyfin | 10.100.4.101 / 192.168.1.226 | Traefik |
| 402 | Media Management | 10.100.4.102 | Traefik, Authelia, VPN (gluetun) |
| 501 | OpenWebUI | 10.100.5.101 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 502 | n8n | 10.100.5.102 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 503 | Obsidian Sync | 10.100.5.103 | Traefik |
| 504 | Documents | 10.100.5.104 | Traefik, Authelia |

## Recovery Procedures

### Single Container Recovery

**Time estimate: 15-30 minutes**

1. **Identify the failed container**

   ```bash
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct list"
   ```

2. **Check available backups**

   ```bash
   task backup:list APP=<app-name>
   # Example: task backup:list APP=immich
   ```

3. **Restore to a new container ID** (safer - allows verification)

   ```bash
   task backup:restore BACKUP=<backup-file> TARGET_ID=<new-id>
   # Example: task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-304-2025_12_07-02_00_00.tar.zst TARGET_ID=350
   ```

4. **Verify the restored container**

   ```bash
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start <new-id>"
   # Check services are running
   ssh root@<container-ip> "docker ps"
   ```

5. **Swap containers** (if verification passes)

   ```bash
   # Stop original
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct stop <original-id>"

   # Update network config on new container to use original IP
   # Then start new container
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start <new-id>"

   # If using OpenTofu, update state:
   task tofu:state:rm APP=<app> RESOURCE="module.<app>.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc"
   ```

### Database Recovery

**Time estimate: 30 minutes**

#### Immich (PostgreSQL with pgvecto-rs)

```bash
# 1. List available dumps
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "ls -lh /tank/backups/database-dumps/immich-postgres-*"

# 2. Restore using task
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
```

#### Jellystat (PostgreSQL)

```bash
# 1. Copy dump to container
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct push 401 /tank/backups/database-dumps/jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz /tmp/"

# 2. SSH to Jellyfin container
ssh root@10.100.4.101

# 3. Restore
docker exec -i jellystat-db psql -U jellystat -d jellystat < /tmp/jellystat-postgres-*.sql
```

#### SQLite Databases (OpenWebUI, n8n)

```bash
# Copy from backup dump directory to container
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct push 501 /tank/backups/database-dumps/openwebui-*.db /config/openwebui/webui.db"

# Restart the service
ssh root@10.100.5.101 "cd /config && docker compose restart"
```

### Network Services Recovery

**Time estimate: 5-10 minutes**

If DNS (AdGuard) is down, LAN devices cannot resolve homelab domains.

1. **Temporary workaround** - Use direct IPs:
   - Proxmox: https://192.168.1.215:8006
   - Traefik: http://192.168.1.235:8080 (dashboard)

2. **Recover AdGuard container**

   ```bash
   # Check container status
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct status 101"

   # Start if stopped
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start 101"

   # Check AdGuard service
   ssh root@10.100.1.101 "docker ps"
   ssh root@10.100.1.101 "cd /config && docker compose up -d"
   ```

3. **Verify DNS resolution**

   ```bash
   dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

### Full Host Recovery

**Time estimate: 2-4 hours**

This procedure assumes complete Proxmox host failure requiring reinstall.

#### Phase 1: Proxmox Installation (30 min)

1. Boot from Proxmox ISO
2. Install to boot drive
3. Configure network:
   - IP: 192.168.1.215/24
   - Gateway: 192.168.1.1
   - DNS: 1.1.1.1 (temporarily)
4. Import ZFS pool:

   ```bash
   zpool import tank
   ```

#### Phase 2: Restore Configuration (30 min)

1. Clone the homelab repo:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/<user>/homelab.git
   cd homelab
   ```

2. Sync backup configuration:

   ```bash
   task backup:sync
   ```

3. Restore containers from local backups (if ZFS pool survived):

   ```bash
   # List available backups
   ls /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/

   # Restore each container - start with Tier 1
   pct restore 101 /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst
   pct restore 200 /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-200-*.tar.zst
   # ... continue for all containers
   ```

#### Phase 3: Cloud Recovery (if local backups lost)

If ZFS pool is lost, restore from Backblaze B2:

1. Install rclone and configure with existing credentials:

   ```bash
   apt install rclone
   # Configure b2 and b2-crypt remotes
   ```

2. Download backups:

   ```bash
   rclone copy b2-crypt:vzdump /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/
   rclone copy b2-crypt:database-dumps /tank/backups/database-dumps/
   ```

3. Restore containers as in Phase 2

#### Phase 4: Verification (30 min)

1. Start containers in dependency order:

   ```bash
   pct start 101  # Network Services
   pct start 200  # Traefik
   pct start 202  # Authelia
   # ... rest of containers
   ```

2. Verify services:

   ```bash
   # DNS
   dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev

   # Web services
   curl -k https://homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

3. Re-apply OpenTofu if needed:

   ```bash
   task tofu:init APP=traefik
   task tofu:plan APP=traefik
   # Review and apply if needed
   ```

## Verification Checklist

After any recovery, verify:

- [ ] DNS resolution working (`dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev`)
- [ ] Traefik dashboard accessible (https://traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev)
- [ ] Authelia login working
- [ ] Homepage loads and shows service status
- [ ] Immich accessible and photos loading
- [ ] Monitoring (Grafana) showing metrics
- [ ] Backups scheduled (`cat /etc/pve/jobs.cfg`)

## Preventive Measures

### Regular Testing

- Monthly: Test restore of one container to verify backups
- Quarterly: Full DR drill - document actual recovery time

### Monitoring Gaps to Address

- [ ] Add backup failure alerting (see proxmox-homelab-v9t)
- [ ] Add Prometheus scrape targets for all services (see proxmox-homelab-30m)

## Contact & Escalation

For issues beyond this runbook:

- Proxmox Forums: https://forum.proxmox.com/
- Backblaze Support: https://www.backblaze.com/help/

### Network Services Recovery

**Time estimate: 5-10 minutes**

If DNS (AdGuard) is down, LAN devices cannot resolve homelab domains.

1. **Temporary workaround** - Use direct IPs:
   - Proxmox: https://192.168.1.215:8006
   - Traefik: http://192.168.1.235:8080 (dashboard)

2. **Recover AdGuard container**

   ```bash
   # Check container status
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct status 101"

   # Start if stopped
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start 101"

   # Check AdGuard service
   ssh root@10.100.1.101 "docker ps"
   ssh root@10.100.1.101 "cd /config && docker compose up -d"
   ```

3. **Verify DNS resolution**

   ```bash
   dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

### Full Host Recovery

**Time estimate: 2-4 hours**

This procedure assumes complete Proxmox host failure requiring reinstall.

#### Phase 1: Proxmox Installation (30 min)

1. Boot from Proxmox ISO
2. Install to boot drive
3. Configure network:
   - IP: 192.168.1.215/24
   - Gateway: 192.168.1.1
   - DNS: 1.1.1.1 (temporarily)
4. Import ZFS pool:

   ```bash
   zpool import tank
   ```

#### Phase 2: Restore Configuration (30 min)

1. Clone the homelab repo:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/<user>/homelab.git
   cd homelab
   ```

2. Sync backup configuration:

   ```bash
   task backup:sync
   ```

3. Restore containers from local backups (if ZFS pool survived):

   ```bash
   # List available backups
   ls /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/

   # Restore each container - start with Tier 1
   pct restore 101 /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst
   pct restore 200 /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-200-*.tar.zst
   # ... continue for all containers
   ```

#### Phase 3: Cloud Recovery (if local backups lost)

If ZFS pool is lost, restore from Backblaze B2:

1. Install rclone and configure with existing credentials:

   ```bash
   apt install rclone
   # Configure b2 and b2-crypt remotes
   ```

2. Download backups:

   ```bash
   rclone copy b2-crypt:vzdump /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/
   rclone copy b2-crypt:database-dumps /tank/backups/database-dumps/
   ```

3. Restore containers as in Phase 2

#### Phase 4: Verification (30 min)

1. Start containers in dependency order:

   ```bash
   pct start 101  # Network Services
   pct start 200  # Traefik
   pct start 202  # Authelia
   # ... rest of containers
   ```

2. Verify services:

   ```bash
   # DNS
   dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev

   # Web services
   curl -k https://homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

3. Re-apply OpenTofu if needed:

   ```bash
   task tofu:init APP=traefik
   task tofu:plan APP=traefik
   # Review and apply if needed
   ```

## Verification Checklist

After any recovery, verify:

- [ ] DNS resolution working (`dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev`)
- [ ] Traefik dashboard accessible (https://traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev)
- [ ] Authelia login working
- [ ] Homepage loads and shows service status
- [ ] Immich accessible and photos loading
- [ ] Monitoring (Grafana) showing metrics
- [ ] Backups scheduled (`cat /etc/pve/jobs.cfg`)

### Regular Testing

- Monthly: Test restore of one container to verify backups

# Homelab Alert Rules
# Only includes alerts for metrics we actually collect

groups:
  - name: services
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      # Prometheus target down
      - alert: TargetDown
        expr: up == 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Target {{ $labels.instance }} is down"
          description: "Prometheus cannot reach {{ $labels.job }} target {{ $labels.instance }}"

      # Traefik high error rate
      - alert: TraefikHighErrorRate
        expr: sum(rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High error rate on Traefik"
          description: "More than 5% of requests are returning 5xx errors"

      # Traefik backend down
      - alert: TraefikBackendDown
        expr: traefik_service_server_up == 0
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Traefik backend {{ $labels.service }} is down"
          description: "Backend service {{ $labels.service }} is not responding"

  - name: proxmox
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      # Proxmox host high CPU
      - alert: ProxmoxHighCPU
        expr: proxmox_node_cpustat_cpu_percent > 80
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High CPU on Proxmox node"
          description: "Proxmox node CPU usage above 80% for 10 minutes (current: {{ $value | printf \"%.1f\" }}%)"

      # Proxmox host memory high
      - alert: ProxmoxHighMemory
        expr: (proxmox_node_memory_memused_bytes / proxmox_node_memory_memtotal_bytes) * 100 > 85
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High memory on Proxmox node"
          description: "Proxmox node memory usage above 85% for 10 minutes"

      # Proxmox storage low
      - alert: ProxmoxStorageLow
        expr: (proxmox_storage_used_bytes / proxmox_storage_total_bytes) * 100 > 85
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "Low storage on {{ $labels.storage }}"
          description: "Proxmox storage {{ $labels.storage }} is above 85% used"

      # Proxmox storage critical
      - alert: ProxmoxStorageCritical
        expr: (proxmox_storage_used_bytes / proxmox_storage_total_bytes) * 100 > 95
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Critical storage on {{ $labels.storage }}"
          description: "Proxmox storage {{ $labels.storage }} is above 95% used"

      # LXC/VM down (no metrics for 5 minutes)
      - alert: ProxmoxVMDown
        expr: changes(proxmox_vm_uptime_seconds[5m]) == 0 and proxmox_vm_uptime_seconds > 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "VM/LXC {{ $labels.name }} may be unresponsive"
          description: "No uptime changes detected for VM/LXC {{ $labels.vmid }} ({{ $labels.name }})"

  - name: monitoring
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      # Prometheus TSDB high cardinality
      - alert: PrometheusTSDBHighCardinality
        expr: prometheus_tsdb_head_series > 100000
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "Prometheus high time series count"
          description: "Prometheus has more than 100k active time series (current: {{ $value }})"

# Alertmanager Configuration
# Routes alerts to ntfy for centralized notification aggregation

global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m

# Route tree
route:
  group_by: ['alertname', 'severity']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  receiver: 'ntfy'

  routes:
    # Critical alerts - immediate notification with high priority
    - match:
        severity: critical
      receiver: 'ntfy-critical'
      group_wait: 10s
      repeat_interval: 1h

    # Warning alerts - batched notifications with default priority
    - match:
        severity: warning
      receiver: 'ntfy'
      group_wait: 1m
      repeat_interval: 4h

# Inhibition rules
inhibit_rules:
  # Inhibit warning if critical is firing for same alertname
  - source_match:
      severity: 'critical'
    target_match:
      severity: 'warning'
    equal: ['alertname', 'instance']

# Receivers
receivers:
  # ntfy receiver for warnings
  - name: 'ntfy'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy - centralized notification aggregator
      # Discord integration will be configured via ntfy webhook subscription
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority=default&tags=warning,homelab'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10

  # ntfy receiver for critical alerts
  - name: 'ntfy-critical'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy with urgent priority
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority=urgent&tags=rotating_light,critical'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10

# Templates for message formatting
templates:
  - '/etc/alertmanager/templates/*.tmpl'

However, since there's no node_exporter running on Proxmox itself currently, a simpler approach is to add a script that sends alerts directly via ntfy when backups fail or are stale.

Let me create a backup monitoring script:

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Proxmox Vzdump Pre-Backup Hook Script
# =============================================================================
# Called by vzdump before/after backing up each container.
# Performs database dumps for containers that need consistent backups.
#
# Arguments passed by vzdump:
#   $1 - phase (job-start, job-end, job-abort, backup-start, backup-end, backup-abort)
#   $2 - mode (stop, suspend, snapshot)
#   $3 - vmid (container/VM ID)
#
# To add a new container with pre-backup tasks:
#   1. Add a case in the backup-start section below
#   2. Run: task backup:sync:hook
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

PHASE="$1"
MODE="${2:-}"
VMID="${3:-}"

LOGFILE="/var/log/vzdump-hooks.log"
DB_DUMP_DIR="/tank/backups/database-dumps"

log() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') [$PHASE] VMID=$VMID: $*" >> "$LOGFILE"
}

# =============================================================================
# Database Backup Functions
# =============================================================================

# Immich PostgreSQL (Container ID: 304)
backup_immich_postgres() {
    log "Dumping Immich PostgreSQL..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/immich-postgres-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql.gz"

    if pct exec 304 -- docker exec immich_postgres \
        pg_dump -U immich -d immich --clean --if-exists 2>/dev/null \
        | gzip > "$DUMP_FILE"; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "Database dump completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: Database dump failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "immich-postgres-*.sql.gz" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# OpenWebUI SQLite (Container ID: 501)
backup_openwebui_sqlite() {
    log "Creating OpenWebUI SQLite backup..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/openwebui-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).db"

    # Copy the SQLite database file directly from the LXC container
    # The volume mount puts webui.db at /config/openwebui/webui.db on the LXC host
    if pct pull 501 /config/openwebui/webui.db "$DUMP_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "SQLite backup completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: SQLite backup failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "openwebui-*.db" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# n8n SQLite (Container ID: 502)
backup_n8n_sqlite() {
    log "Creating n8n SQLite backup..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/n8n-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).db"

    # Copy the SQLite database file directly from the LXC container
    # n8n stores its database at /config/n8n/database.sqlite
    if pct pull 502 /config/n8n/database.sqlite "$DUMP_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "SQLite backup completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: SQLite backup failed (container may not exist yet)"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "n8n-*.db" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Jellyfin Jellystat PostgreSQL (Container ID: 401)
backup_jellystat_postgres() {
    log "Dumping Jellystat PostgreSQL..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/jellystat-postgres-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql.gz"

    # Jellystat uses postgres:15-alpine with database "jellystat" and user "jellystat"
    if pct exec 401 -- docker exec jellystat-db \
        pg_dump -U jellystat -d jellystat --clean --if-exists 2>/dev/null \
        | gzip > "$DUMP_FILE"; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "Database dump completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: Jellystat database dump failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 4 weeks for weekly backups)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz" -mtime +28 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Logic
# =============================================================================

case "$PHASE" in
    job-start)
        mkdir -p "$DB_DUMP_DIR"
        log "Backup job starting"
        ;;

    backup-start)
        log "Backup starting (mode: $MODE)"

        # Container-specific pre-backup tasks
        case "$VMID" in
            304)
                # Immich - dump PostgreSQL before backup
                backup_immich_postgres || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            401)
                # Jellyfin - dump Jellystat PostgreSQL before backup
                backup_jellystat_postgres || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            501)
                # OpenWebUI - backup SQLite database
                backup_openwebui_sqlite || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            502)
                # n8n - backup SQLite database
                backup_n8n_sqlite || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            *)
                # No pre-backup tasks for this container
                ;;
        esac
        ;;

    backup-end)
        log "Backup completed"
        ;;

    backup-abort)
        log "WARNING: Backup aborted"
        ;;

    job-end)
        log "Backup job completed"
        ;;

    job-abort)
        log "ERROR: Backup job aborted"
        ;;

    *)
        log "Unknown phase: $PHASE"
        ;;
esac

exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Backup Freshness Monitor
# =============================================================================
# Checks that backups are not stale and sends alerts via ntfy if issues found.
# Run via cron on Proxmox: 0 6 * * * /var/lib/vz/snippets/backup-monitor.sh
#
# Exit codes:
#   0 - All backups OK
#   1 - Alert sent (stale or missing backups)
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

BACKUP_DIR="/tank/backups/vzdump/dump"
DB_DUMP_DIR="/tank/backups/database-dumps"
NTFY_URL="${NTFY_URL:-http://10.100.5.100:8093/homelab-alerts}"
LOGFILE="/var/log/backup-monitor.log"

# Thresholds in hours
DAILY_THRESHOLD=36    # Alert if daily backups > 36 hours old
WEEKLY_THRESHOLD=192  # Alert if weekly backups > 8 days old

log() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') $*" >> "$LOGFILE"
}

send_alert() {
    local priority="$1"
    local title="$2"
    local message="$3"
    local tags="$4"

    log "ALERT [$priority]: $title - $message"

    curl -s -o /dev/null \
        -H "Title: $title" \
        -H "Priority: $priority" \
        -H "Tags: $tags" \
        -d "$message" \
        "$NTFY_URL" || log "Failed to send ntfy alert"
}

# Check age of most recent backup file matching pattern
check_backup_age() {
    local pattern="$1"
    local name="$2"
    local threshold_hours="$3"
    local dir="${4:-$BACKUP_DIR}"

    local newest
    newest=$(find "$dir" -name "$pattern" -type f -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-)

    if [[ -z "$newest" ]]; then
        send_alert "urgent" "Backup Missing: $name" "No backups found matching $pattern" "warning,backup"
        return 1
    fi

    local age_seconds
    age_seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$newest") ))
    local age_hours=$(( age_seconds / 3600 ))

    if [[ $age_hours -gt $threshold_hours ]]; then
        local age_days=$(( age_hours / 24 ))
        send_alert "high" "Stale Backup: $name" "Last backup is ${age_days}d ${age_hours}h old (threshold: ${threshold_hours}h). File: $(basename "$newest")" "warning,backup,clock"
        return 1
    fi

    log "OK: $name - newest backup is ${age_hours}h old ($(basename "$newest"))"
    return 0
}

# =============================================================================
# Main
# =============================================================================

log "Starting backup freshness check"
ALERT_COUNT=0

# Daily backups (should be < 36 hours old)
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-304-*.tar.zst" "Immich (304)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

check_backup_age "n8n-*.db" "n8n DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

# Proxmox Backup Operations
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# Handles vzdump backups, Immich database dumps, and restore operations

version: '3'

tasks:
  backup:sync:
    desc: "Sync backup configs (jobs.cfg + hook script) to Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing backup configuration to Proxmox..."
        scp ./scripts/backup/jobs.cfg root@homelab:/etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        scp ./scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh root@homelab:/var/lib/vz/snippets/
        ssh root@homelab "chmod +x /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh"
        echo "Backup configuration synced successfully"

  backup:status:
    desc: "Show backup storage status and recent backups"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-status.sh

  backup:now:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-app.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:all:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for all containers"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

  backup:list:
    desc: "List backups for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-list.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:restore:
    desc: "Restore container from backup (BACKUP=filename, TARGET_ID=container_id)"
    requires:
      vars: [BACKUP, TARGET_ID]
    prompt: "This will restore {{.BACKUP}} to container {{.TARGET_ID}}. Continue?"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct restore {{.TARGET_ID}} /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/{{.BACKUP}} --storage nvme-containers"

  backup:immich:db:
    desc: "Manually dump Immich PostgreSQL database"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh dump

  backup:immich:db:restore:
    desc: "Restore Immich database from dump (DUMP=filename)"
    requires:
      vars: [DUMP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh restore {{.DUMP}}

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenTelemetry Collector - Central telemetry receiver and router
  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.115.1
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-monitoring
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:
  portainer_agent_data:

# OpenTelemetry Collector Configuration
# Receives telemetry from Proxmox and other sources, exports to Prometheus

receivers:
  # OTLP receiver for Proxmox native metrics and future traces/logs
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318

  # Host metrics from the monitoring container itself
  hostmetrics:
    collection_interval: 30s
    scrapers:
      cpu:
      memory:
      disk:
      filesystem:
      network:
      load:

processors:
  # Batch processor for better performance
  batch:
    timeout: 10s
    send_batch_size: 1000

  # Memory limiter to prevent OOM
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_mib: 512
    spike_limit_mib: 128

  # Add resource attributes
  resource:
    attributes:
      - key: deployment.environment
        value: homelab
        action: upsert

exporters:
  # Prometheus exporter - exposes metrics at 8889 for Prometheus to scrape
  prometheus:
    endpoint: "0.0.0.0:8889"
    namespace: homelab
    resource_to_telemetry_conversion:
      enabled: true

  # Remote write to Prometheus for OTLP metrics (using container IP)
  prometheusremotewrite:
    endpoint: "http://192.168.1.229:9090/api/v1/write"

  # Debug exporter for troubleshooting (logs to stdout)
  debug:
    verbosity: basic

extensions:
  # Health check for monitoring the collector itself
  health_check:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:13133

  # Performance profiling
  pprof:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:1777

  # zPages for debugging
  zpages:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:55679

service:
  extensions: [health_check, pprof, zpages]

  pipelines:
    # Metrics pipeline
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp, hostmetrics]
      processors: [memory_limiter, batch, resource]
      exporters: [prometheusremotewrite]

    # Traces pipeline (ready for future use)
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, batch, resource]
      exporters: [debug]

    # Logs pipeline (ready for future use with Loki)
    logs:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, batch, resource]
      exporters: [debug]

  telemetry:
    logs:
      level: info
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
        - pull:
            exporter:
              prometheus:
                host: "0.0.0.0"
                port: 8888

# Prometheus Configuration

global:
  scrape_interval: 30s
  evaluation_interval: 30s
  external_labels:
    monitor: 'homelab'

# Alerting configuration
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets:
            - alertmanager:9093

# Rule files for alerts
rule_files:
  - /etc/prometheus/alerts/*.yml

# Scrape configurations
scrape_configs:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Monitoring Stack Self-Monitoring
  # ==========================================================================

  # Prometheus self-monitoring
  - job_name: 'prometheus'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['localhost:9090']

  # OpenTelemetry Collector metrics
  - job_name: 'otel-collector'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['otel-collector:8888']

  - job_name: 'alertmanager'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['alertmanager:9093']

  # Grafana metrics

    static_configs:
      - targets: ['grafana:3000']

  # Traefik Reverse Proxy Metrics
  # ==========================================================================
  - job_name: 'traefik'

      - targets: ['10.100.2.200:8082']

          lxc_id: '200'

# =============================================================================
# Shared Configuration
# =============================================================================
# This file is symlinked into each app directory to provide common variables
# and provider configuration. Each app has its own state file.
#
# Secret Management:
# - State encryption passphrase: Must remain as TF_VAR (needed before providers init)
# - All other secrets: Fetched from 1Password via onepassword provider
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# State Encryption (Required as TF_VAR - runs before providers)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "state_encryption_passphrase" {
  description = "Passphrase for encrypting state files (from 1Password: op://homelab/opentofu/password)"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "proxmox_endpoint" {
  description = "Proxmox API endpoint URL"
  type        = string
  default     = "https://192.168.1.215:8006"
}

variable "proxmox_node" {
  description = "Proxmox node name"
  type        = string
  default     = "pve"
}

variable "proxmox_ssh_host" {
  description = "Proxmox host SSH address (for configuring privileged containers)"
  type        = string
  default     = "192.168.1.215"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SSH Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "ssh_private_key_path" {
  description = "Path to SSH private key"
  type        = string
  default     = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519"
}

variable "ssh_public_key_path" {
  description = "Path to SSH public key"
  type        = string
  default     = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519.pub"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Storage & Network Defaults
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "default_storage" {
  description = "Default storage for LXC containers"
  type        = string
  default     = "tank"
}

variable "default_bridge" {
  description = "Default network bridge"
  type        = string
  default     = "vmbr0"
}

variable "lxc_template" {
  description = "Default LXC template (base Debian)"
  type        = string
  default     = "local:vztmpl/debian-13-standard_13.1-2_amd64.tar.zst"
}

variable "lxc_template_docker" {
  description = "LXC template with Docker pre-installed"
  type        = string
  default     = "local:vztmpl/debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Domain Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "domain_internal" {
  description = "Internal domain suffix"
  type        = string
  default     = "homelab.rambtech.dev"
}

variable "domain_public" {
  description = "Public domain"
  type        = string
  default     = "rambtech.dev"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Configuration (IDs only - tokens from 1Password)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "cloudflare_account_id" {
  description = "Cloudflare account ID"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  description = "Cloudflare zone ID"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "cloudflare_tunnel_id" {
  description = "Cloudflare tunnel ID"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Computed Locals
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

locals {
  ssh_public_key = file(var.ssh_public_key_path)
}

# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR
  # ==========================================================================
  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.2
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      # Allow CSRF from both internal and public domains
      - PAPERLESS_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,docs.rambtech.dev,localhost
      - PAPERLESS_CORS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    depends_on:
      paperless-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: paperless-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=paperless
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=paperless
    volumes:
      - paperless-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Redis - Cache/Broker for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-redis:
    image: redis:7.4-alpine
    container_name: paperless-redis
    volumes:
      - paperless-redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Stirling-PDF - PDF Manipulation Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  # Comprehensive PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, OCR, convert, etc.
  # Stateless service - no persistent data needed.
  stirling-pdf:
    image: stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:2.1.3
    container_name: stirling-pdf
    environment:
      - DOCKER_ENABLE_SECURITY=false
      - SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN=false
      - SYSTEM_DEFAULTLOCALE=en_US
      - UI_APPNAME=Stirling PDF
      - UI_HOMEDESCRIPTION=PDF tools for the homelab
      - METRICS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Training data for better OCR (optional)
      - stirling-tessdata:/usr/share/tessdata
      # Custom configurations
      - stirling-configs:/configs
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8080/api/v1/info/status || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)

# Dashy Dashboard Configuration - PUBLIC SERVICES
# This dashboard is intended for public/family access
# Documentation: https://dashy.to/docs/

pageInfo:
  title: Rambtech Services
  description: Family services portal
  logo: https://github.com/Lissy93/dashy/raw/master/public/web-icons/dashy-logo.png
  footerText: Rambtech Family Services

appConfig:
  theme: nord-frost
  layout: auto
  iconSize: large
  language: en
  startingView: default
  defaultOpeningMethod: newtab
  statusCheck: true
  statusCheckInterval: 300
  faviconApi: local
  routingMode: history
  enableMultiTasking: false
  widgetsAlwaysUseProxy: false
  webSearch:
    searchEngine: google
    openingMethod: newtab
  hideComponents:
    hideHeading: false
    hideNav: true
    hideSearch: true
    hideSettings: true
    hideFooter: false

sections:
  # Main Services - Public Access
  - name: Services
    icon: fas fa-home
    displayData:
      sortBy: default
      rows: 1
      cols: 4
      collapsed: false
      itemSize: large
    items:
      - title: Photos
        description: Family photo library - View and share memories
        url: https://photos.rambtech.dev
        icon: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/immich-app/immich/main/docs/static/img/favicon.png
        target: newtab
        id: 0_photos
        statusCheck: true
        statusCheckUrl: http://192.168.1.222:2283/api/server/ping

      - title: AI Chat
        description: Chat with AI assistant - Ask questions, get help
        url: https://ai.rambtech.dev
        icon: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-webui/open-webui/main/static/favicon.png
        target: newtab
        id: 1_ai_chat
        statusCheck: true
        statusCheckUrl: http://192.168.1.221:3000

      - title: Movies & TV
        description: Stream movies and TV shows
        url: https://jellyfin.rambtech.dev
        icon: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-ux/master/branding/SVG/icon-transparent.svg
        target: newtab
        id: 2_jellyfin
        statusCheck: true
        statusCheckUrl: http://192.168.1.226:8096

      - title: Request Media
        description: Request movies and TV shows
        url: https://requests.rambtech.dev
        icon: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fallenbagel/jellyseerr/develop/public/logo_full.svg
        target: newtab
        id: 3_jellyseerr
        statusCheck: true
        statusCheckUrl: http://192.168.1.226:5055

  # Quick Links (collapsed by default)
  - name: Quick Links
    icon: fas fa-link
    displayData:
      sortBy: default
      rows: 1
      cols: 2
      collapsed: false
      itemSize: large
    items:
      - title: Internal Dashboard
        description: Admin access (requires VPN)
        url: https://homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
        icon: hl-homepage
        target: newtab
        id: 0_admin

      - title: Tailscale Login
        description: VPN for remote admin access
        url: https://login.tailscale.com
        icon: favicon
        target: newtab
        id: 1_tailscale

# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless section fields into a map by label
  _paperless_section_fields = merge([
    for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
      for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# Portainer Edge Agent
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # NOTE: Do NOT pass portainer_edge_id/key here - we handle the combined .env file
  # ourselves (including both paperless secrets AND portainer credentials).
  # The module's portainer env feature only supports portainer-only env files.

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    paperless_public      = "https://docs.${var.domain_public}"
    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_public   = "https://pdf.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Paperless-ngx", port = 8000, info = "Document management with OCR" },
    { name = "Stirling-PDF", port = 8080, info = "PDF manipulation tools" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Paperless database (internal)" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Paperless cache (internal)" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

}

# =============================================================================
# OpenWebUI LXC - AI Chat Interface with Ollama
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 501
# IP: 192.168.1.221
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
